items.summary: Greetings to all of you! This is the festive season; the nation is filled with celebration, enthusiasm, and energy. In this atmosphere of joy and celebration, I welcome and greet all of you friends who have come here from all over the world.
items.title: English rendering of PM's address in NDTV World Summit

items.summary: Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi today addressed the NDTV World Summit 2026 in New Delhi. Greeting the international delegates amidst the joyous festive season in the country, the Prime Minister welcomed the participants to the summit. He commended the gathering for deliberating on serious global matters.
items.title: Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi addresses the NDTV World Summit 2026 in New Delhi

items.summary: Union Secretary, Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Sudhansh Pant, today lauded Jammu and Kashmir’s extensive grassroots outreach under social welfare schemes and its coordinated, whole-of government approach to combating drug abuse, describing the UT’s efforts as a commendable model with potential for replication across the country.
items.title: Union Secretary MoSJ&E Shri Sudhansh Pant Lauds J&K’s Grassroots Welfare Outreach, Whole-Of-Government Approach Against Drug Abuse
